name: RateCardDealEstimator
tagline: Role-based deal estimates with live margin, discount approval tiers and scenario comparison.
description: A complete professional-services pricing module for Power Apps and Power Pages: build estimates from your rate card, see margin and blended rate live, route discounts to the right approver, compare staffing scenarios side by side and let clients accept proposals online.
features: Live net fees, cost, margin % and blended rate
Configurable discount approval tiers with approver limit
Margin target and floor with gauge
Apply discount, price to target margin, reset to rate card
Scenario duplication, comparison and preferred scenario
Client proposal mode for Power Pages (accept / decline)
Demo mode, Power Fx outputs and six events
